title.narrative: Eastern Partnership Civil Society Facility: Regional Technical Assistance to Build Civil Society Capacities

description.narrative: This Technical Assistance project will contribute to strengthening and promoting the role of civil society in reforms and democratic changes in the Eastern Partnership countries, creating synergies between various EU-funded bilateral and regional initiatives for civil society organisations. It will implement capacity building activities (including Civil Society Fellowships, e-Learning and training, civic-tech and communication activities) and conduct studies and mappings.
